meeting.type: Special Session — Budget Assumptions Work Session
meeting.summary: Capital-projects ranking with ~$10.8M of unallocated General Fund balance. Discussion covered a Long-Term Facilities Plan consultant; right-of-way for Mid Valley Road, Hidden Valley Parkway, and Lone Tree Parkway to Old Airport Road; the High-T intersection and traffic signals at Stone Bridge Lane and Woodhaven Boulevard; wastewater headworks expansion and rapid-infiltration basin rehab; Pony Express Regional Trail addition to the impact-fee plan; and three additional Sheriff's positions (with a fourth advocated for January).
